title: In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/env-gate-scan.ts, the constant named GUARD_RE matches only boolean capability
description: In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/env-gate-scan.ts, the constant named GUARD_RE matches only boolean capability guard forms, so an environment variable read that supplies a numeric default is never flagged as an env gate. Add one more alternative to that single regular expression so it also matches a nullish-coalescing operator, written as two consecutive question marks. Do not add any import. Do not modify any other line or any other function. The change must typecheck.
